title: Deformation-uniform Beauville–Bogomolov bounds ensuring pseudoeffectivity of twisted cotangent classes on compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifolds
source_title: Twisted cotangent bundle of Hyperkähler manifolds  (with an appendix by Simone Diverio)
author: Fabrizio Anella; Andreas Höring
difficulty_reason: The cited Kähler-cone criterion does not provide a single threshold across all relevant cycle classes and all members of the deformation family. The authors reduce the cycle intersections to Beauville--Bogomolov polynomials and prove a uniform largest-root bound. The complete positive-current compactness and specialization argument in Diverio's Appendix then transfers very-general positivity to the arbitrary member and the boundary nef-and-big case.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Only the sufficient pseudoeffectivity assertion of Theorem1.3: compact complex hyper-Kähler in the explicit simply connected irreducible holomorphic symplectic sense, dimension2n, nef and big real(1,1)-class omega, and a nonnegative finite bound depending on deformation type. Exact projectivized cotangent tautological class zeta+pi^*omega retained. Full polynomial intersection/root-bound argument and Appendix positive-current specialization by Simone Diverio read. Demailly–Paun criterion, Verbitsky/Huybrechts deformation-invariant cohomology formulas and countability/properness of cycle spaces are explicit existing research foundations. No asserted converse from nonnegative polynomial values to largest-root position, no optimal numerical Hilbert-scheme threshold, and no equality of nef/pseudoeffective cones selected. The appendix supporting author Simone Diverio is explicitly credited on the preserved source pages.
